subject: Mutual action plan: trial infra options & owners
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@carexhealth.com>, Josh Patel <josh.patel@carexhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed MAP: trial infra options and owners

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposal for next steps so we have clarity on hosting options and who owns each piece for the POC. High level from our side: we can support three trial modes (hosted API sandbox, dedicated sandbox, VPC/private deployment) and each has trade-offs for time-to-first-query, telemetry, and data controls.

Key inputs from your side:
- Use case: clinical triage assistant (PHI-limited) integrated into CareX triage UI
- Success criteria: 90th pct latency < 800ms for short prompts, 95% semantic match to the eval set, and no PHI exfiltration to 3rd-party logs
- Timeline preference: 6-week POC (kickoff next Monday preferred)

My proposed MAP (mutual action plan) and owners:
1) Decide hosting mode by 2026-07-16 — owners: CareX IT (Samantha) + Redwood sales (Ben)
2) Security questionnaire + evidence package (SOC2 summary, KMS options) — owner: CareX security (Josh) will review; Redwood (Marissa) to supply artifacts by 2026-07-16
3) Environment spin-up: if Hosted sandbox -> Redwood teams provision (Marissa) within 2 business days after signature; Dedicated sandbox -> provisioning ETA 7–10 days (infra request + reserved capacity); VPC -> design + network review 2+ weeks
4) Evaluation plan: Redwood will seed an eval harness and sample prompts; CareX will provide 25 representative user flows and a small test dataset (anonymized) by 2026-07-19

Attachments: I attached a short hosting comparison and a draft MAP for you to review. If we align on hosted sandbox we can get a working demo within 48 hours after the PO/MAP signoff.

Next step: can you confirm decision owner and whether hosted sandbox is acceptable as a fast path? If yes, Ben and I will prepare access tokens and a minimal dataset onboarding checklist.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: redwood-hosting-comparison.pdf (3 pages), MAP-CareX-v1.docx (editable), sandbox-onramp-checklist.xlsx
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@carexhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Josh Patel <josh.patel@carexhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MAP: trial infra options and owners

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Decision owner for hosting: that's me (Samantha) coordinating with IT (Josh). I want hosted sandbox as the preferred fast path but we need to validate that logs and telemetry can be scoped to non-PHI only.
- Timeline: 6-week POC works, but we need the security artifacts before we sign anything. Josh, can you confirm how long it will take to run through Redwood's standard questionnaire?
- Success criteria: Can you add a simple pass/fail checklist for PHI controls (no raw transcripts stored outside CareX-controlled storage, KMS key control, audit logs accessible)? That will help our compliance team.

We can commit to providing the 25 representative flows by 2026-07-19 if the MAP is updated to include the PHI checklist and the hosting gating criteria. Asking for Ben and Marissa to align on the hosted sandbox quickstart steps so we know what to expect after signoff.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Head of Product 
CareX Health
T: +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@carexhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Josh Patel <josh.patel@carexhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MAP: trial infra options and owners

Appreciate the quick reply, Samantha — we can absolutely add a PHI gating checklist to the MAP. High level commitments from Redwood for the hosted sandbox fast path: 

- Data controls: by default, hosted sandbox will redact or not persist fields flagged by CareX; if you need KMS-backed isolation we can enable customer-managed keys (requires a short legal addendum).
- Audit logs: read-only access to request/response metadata (no raw transcripts unless explicitly permitted). We'll include a sample audit export in the evidence package.
- Time to live: sandbox accounts expire automatically after the POC window unless extended.

Operational owners and immediate asks: 
- Redwood (Marissa): deliver SOC2 summary + sample audit export + updated MAP with PHI checklist by 2026-07-16 COB PT
- CareX (Samantha): confirm hosted sandbox approval (fast path) or signal dedicated/VPC by 2026-07-16 EOD ET
- CareX (Josh): confirm security questionnaire timeline by 2026-07-16

If we get the MAP signed and your dataset by 7/19, Marissa and I can spin up the hosted sandbox and invite your engineers by 7/21. For dedicated or VPC we'll provide a separate timeline (longer).

I'll follow up with a short action tracker and an updated MAP in the thread.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@carexhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MAP: trial infra options and owners — updated MAP + artifacts

Samantha / team — attaching an updated MAP that includes the PHI gating checklist and a short hosting comparison table. Summary of what's attached and next steps below.

Attachments included:
- MAP-CareX-v1.docx (updated: PHI checklist + signoff rows)
- redwood-hosting-comparison.pdf (adds KMS and telemetry columns)
- sandbox-onramp-checklist.xlsx (minimal access steps and sample token rotation guidance)

What Redwood is ready to do now (hosted sandbox fast path):
1) Provide SOC2 summary + sample audit export (attached) — Marissa done 2026-07-20
2) Provision hosted sandbox after signed MAP and short PO — estimated 48 hours to first-access
3) Provide a seed eval harness and sample prompts — Ben to provide by 7/21

CareX asks outstanding:
- Samantha: confirm hosted sandbox approval or request dedicated/VPC by 7/21 EOD ET
- Josh: confirm security questionnaire timing — if you can provide initial answers in the next 48 hours we can proceed in parallel with provisioning steps
- CareX engineering: send the 25 representative flows (anonymized) to marissa.cole@redwood.com by 7/23 so Ben can map them into the harness

If there's appetite to sign the MAP electronically, here's a DocuSign link that can be used: https://app.docusign.com/packets/abc123. Once signed we will issue a sandbox token and an onboarding session slot.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
